track_A_22_16_22_24C.exposure: Top-10 DCG position weight 1/log2(rank+2), split across verified genres (legacy 22.16 ledger)
track_A_22_16_22_24C.opportunity: normalized Top-500 DCG weights, split across verified genres

track_B_proposal_eq_21_to_25.category_weight_source: equal-category sensitivity convention (not specified by proposal)
track_B_proposal_eq_21_to_25.baseline: UNAVAILABLE: event-item contextual relevance q[e,i] is missing.
track_B_proposal_eq_21_to_25.proposed: UNAVAILABLE: event-item contextual relevance q[e,i] is missing.
limitations: Frozen 22.24B event outputs do not contain event-item contextual relevance q[e,i].
KG rank/confidence and candidate-pool category prevalence are not substitutes for semantic dialogue relevance.
Proposal Eq. (21)-(22) use binary multi-label membership without dividing contributions by the number of categories; this differs from the legacy 22.16 ledger.
The proposal does not numerically specify omega_c or the minimum relevance-support threshold; these must be reported as analysis choices.

interpretation: Track A opportunity-normalized log-rate MAD and Track B relevance-normalized within-category weighted variance are different estimands.
